model_annotation: Figure 4 presents a grouped bar chart illustrating the distribution of five types of labels across training and validation sets, alongside their corresponding accuracy rates. The horizontal axis categorizes the five label types: 实体识别 (Entity Recognition), 角色识别 (Role Recognition), 异常识别 (Anomaly Recognition), 空间推理 (Spatial Reasoning), and 同义识别 (Synonym Recognition). The vertical axis on the left represents the quantity of samples, scaled linearly from 0 to 1200, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 200. The vertical axis on the right represents accuracy, scaled linearly from 0 to 1, with labeled tick marks at intervals of 0.1. Each category has two adjacent bars: a blue bar representing the training set size and an orange bar representing the validation set size. A line graph overlays the bars, with data points indicating the accuracy for each category. The blue bars (training set sizes) are labeled with their approximate values: 1102, 1095, 1077, 1210, and 5. The orange bars (validation set sizes) are labeled with their approximate values: 250, 190, 40, 675, and 55. The accuracy line graph connects the points: 0.7666, 0.8714, 0.6992, 0.2852, and 0.3769. The chart does not show any explicit sorting of categories or visual emphasis on any particular bar.
